notes: §1985:XV.3.2.4 GR14: "the occurrence number of each level is entered in DEBUG-SUB-1, DEBUG-SUB-2, DEBUG-SUB-3" for the subscripted or indexed reference that caused the section. DebugTriggerEmitter.OccurrenceNumbers renders each subscripted level of the fire's place and DebugItem.SubImage writes it; the witness (indexes, relative indexing, three levels) and probes (dbg/g14, g14b: ODO element OE (4), BIG (10005) -> +0005, BIG (BX + 1) -> +2000, kb/Work PB5294's sending-operand case) print the right numbers. The place is identified as its statement identifies it: once at the start of the statement (DebugTriggerEmitter.IdentifiedOnce, §1985:IV.4.3.8, kb/Work PB5294), and, for a receiver whose statement's rules say "Unless otherwise" (MOVE identifier-2, §1985:VI.6.19.4 GR2; the arithmetic multiple results, §1985:VI.6.4.6 GR2; DIVIDE REMAINDER, §1985:VI.6.11.4 GR4; SET identifier-1, §1985:VI.6.23.4 GR3d; READ or RETURN INTO, §1985:VII.4.4.4 GR8b), again at its store into the same statement locals (DebugTriggerEmitter.IdentifiedAtStore through PlaceIdentification.IdentifyInto, rendered by MoveEmitter.EmitReceiver, ArithmeticEmitter.ReceiverStore and SetEmitter.EmitSetTo; kb/Work PB5385). Witness pb5385-debug-receiver-identified-at-store: MOVE 3 TO SUB NT (SUB) +0003, MOVE 4 TO NT (SUB) SUB +0001, ADD 1 TO SUB NT (SUB) +0002, COMPUTE SUB NT (SUB) = 4 +0004, DIVIDE 7 BY 2 GIVING SUB REMAINDER NT (SUB) +0003, SET SUB NT (SUB) TO IX +0005, READ F INTO XE (FR-SUB) +0003.
